name: ssh-option-witness
user: Developer debugging host-specific SSH client settings.
pain: Show which matching declaration supplied a value without connecting or executing commands.
smallest_capability: Strict documented Host/option subset, first scalar value and additive identity files, with source line trace and skipped override reasons.
acceptance: Positive and negated host patterns, case-insensitive host matching.
Earlier scalar wins; additive identity files preserve declaration order.
Reject Include, Match and unsupported options rather than ignoring them.
demand: Inferred from OpenSSH configuration semantics and established parser workflows; no verified request.
distinctness: Existing network tools do not resolve host declarations.
limits: No full OpenSSH emulation, includes, token expansion, command execution, filesystem lookup or connections.
publication: Website publication in progress; remote CI not yet verified
